from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    line_color = next((c for c in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if any(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid)), None)
    if line_color is None:
        return out
    line_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == line_color for x in row))
    obj = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg, line_color)]
    if not obj:
        return out
    # Move the non-background object toward the full-width divider until adjacent.
    minr, maxr = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    if maxr < line_r:
        shift = line_r - 1 - maxr
    elif minr > line_r:
        shift = line_r + 1 - minr
    else:
        shift = 0
    for r, c in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    moved = [(r + shift, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in obj]
    for r, c, v in moved:
        out[r][c] = v
    lo = min(r for r, c, v in moved)
    hi = max(r for r, c, v in moved)
    trail = hi + 1 if line_r < lo else lo - 1
    if 0 <= trail < h:
        out[trail] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-44ca1d79.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
